data.description: Private Beach Access | Fully Furnished | Breathtaking Views
data.long_description:
1/JBR – A breathtaking architectural landmark rising above the Dubai skyline, 1/JBR stands as the gateway to the exclusive Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR). This stunning 43-story tower features opulent apartments that offer an unparalleled living experience. With its prime location, renowned address, and meticulously crafted interiors, 1/JBR is set to transform the concept of luxury beachside living in the heart of JBR, Dubai.

Property Features:-

2 Bedrooms
3 Bathrooms
2 Parking
Full Palm and Sea views

Chic, private and meticulously planned, the apartment's are replete with unique features, designer fittings, customized glass facades and spacious sundecks that afford breathtaking panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Palm Jumeirah.
 
Communal spaces – the lobby, swimming pool and gym – all bear the hallmarks of high quality, cutting edge design, while semi-private lifts, private lobbies and a VIP parking service reinforce the exclusivity of this residential tower.
